## Appearance

Ned Land is a tall, strongly built man standing over six feet high. His prominent stature makes him easily distinguishable among others.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014)_

## Personality

A tall and strongly built Canadian, this individual possesses a grave, taciturn demeanor that hides violent instincts and a passionate nature when contradicted. Known for his uncommon quickness of hand, physical strength, and skill as a cook, he is as handy with a pickaxe as he is with a harpoon. Over time, his growing obstinacy, bad humor, and intense love of liberty drive a resolute desire to escape captivity aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and land on terra firma. He actively seeks opportunities to flee the vessel, whether by finding a cavern exit, mastering the pinnace, or even leaping into the sea if another vessel passes near. Driven by a longing for freedom—and a strong craving for meat—he remains intensely focused on reaching land.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P37](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P74](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0074), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P67](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P101](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0101), +14 more_

## History

Ned Land, a Canadian harpooner native to [Quebec](../codex/places.md#quebec) who hailed from a family of fishermen and hunted whales in northern seas, joined the expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea creature. After months of searching, Ned spotted the target in the darkness of the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), but his harpoon strike resulted in a collision that threw him, Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) into the sea. Taking refuge on a metallic submarine, they were pulled inside and trapped as prisoners of Captain Nemo aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Reluctant to embrace his permanent imprisonment, Ned frequently lost his temper and sought opportunities to escape. Despite his desire for freedom, he joined underwater excursions, including a hunt where he helped kill a shark that attacked an Indian pearl diver, saving Captain Nemo's life. He also successfully harpooned a massive dugong while traveling through the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and explored an extinct volcano with his companions. As the submarine continued its journey, Ned repeatedly pressured [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to secure their release, but [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) firmly refused. When the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) rammed and destroyed an unknown warship, Ned seized the next opportunity to flee, organizing a night escape in the ship's small boat. Although the boat was ripped free as the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) was caught in the deadly Norwegian maelstrom, Ned survived the dangerous ordeal and regained consciousness alongside his companions in a fisherman's hut in the Lofoten Isles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), +52 more_

## Quotes

> “Wooden ships—that is possible,” replied the Canadian, “but I have never seen it done; and, until further proof, I deny that whales, cetaceans, or sea-unicorns could ever produce the effect you describe.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019)

> "You have convinced me of one thing, sir, which is that, if such animals do exist at the bottom of the seas, they must necessarily be as strong as you say."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P37](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0037)

> "The Captain must be very sure of his route, for I see there pieces of coral that would do for its keel if it only touched them slightly."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013)

> "Sir, you may believe me when I tell you that this piece of iron will navigate neither on nor under the sea again; it is only fit to be sold for its weight. I think, therefore, that the time has come to part company with Captain Nemo."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034)

> "But do they know, at least, how to act circumspectly? There is an island; on that island there are trees; under those trees, terrestrial animals, bearers of cutlets and roast beef, to which I would willingly give a trial."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P36](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--ned-land.md)

Ned Land and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) first met aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during the hunt for the sea monster, where they debated the creature's existence on the deck. After Ned harpooned the beast, both men were cast into the ocean and ultimately brought aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as fellow captives. They share a bond as friends and traveling companions, enduring their common imprisonment despite Ned's violent outbursts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), +25 more_

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Ned Land and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) bonded after being pulled from the sea and held captive together inside the metallic submarine. As cabin mates and friends aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), they share the experience of living under Captain Nemo's captivity. Despite the tense conditions—such as when a starving Ned lost his temper and attacked a steward—they remain close comrades throughout their imprisonment.
